dedupe_keys.name: autodrive simulation and autonomy development platform

description: AutoDRIVE is developed by the Tinker Twins team for autonomous-driving research and transfer between simulation and a scaled physical testbed. Its Unity simulator represents the Nigel vehicle and modular traffic infrastructure, while the developer kit supports autonomy and smart-city traffic-control algorithms. Inputs are simulated environments and control commands; outputs are vehicle and sensor responses exchanged through WebSockets, with Python, C++ and ROS support. Coverage is a configurable test environment, without a fixed city or historical period. Repository source is free under BSD-2-Clause; Unity and physical hardware have separate requirements. A limitation is that the scaled testbed and its digital representation do not establish full-size vehicle or city-level validity. AutoDRIVE can test road-vehicle control and traffic-management interactions. SUMO (model-sumo) supplies related traffic-network simulation. This parent record covers the simulator, testbed documentation and developer kit branches. No simulator binary, hardware design archive or dataset was downloaded.
